'''Francesco Accattatis''' is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the image on two cards: [[His Destiny|•His Destiny]] and [[Young Skywalker|•Young Skywalker]].<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref><ref name="pcimages">Players Committee card images at res.starwarsccg.org (Virtual Sets 0–27, Virtual Premium and alternate images at 745 × 1039; Virtual Blocks 1–9 and Virtual Shields at 350 × 490), the source the card label data was read from. Each card's article shows its image.</ref> The credit on •Young Skywalker ([[Virtual Set 22]]) also names [[Card Credits#Philip Gilbert|Philip Gilbert]]. The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Set 21]] (2023) and [[Virtual Set 22]] (2023). Francesco Accattatis is listed on [[Card Credits#Francesco Accattatis|Card Credits]].

''Year'' is the set's release date (Virtual Sets) or the date its official text took effect (Virtual Blocks), as given in the set's article. Alternate-image (AI, ALT) and back faces are counted as separate cards, as on [[Card Credits]].
